subject: Request: Summer compute supplement for Data Curation Consortium
messages:
From: Dr. Hannah Li <hannah.li@midwest.edu>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Summer compute supplement for Data Curation Consortium

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the pilot credits you provided earlier this year — the team at the Midwest University Research Consortium (MURC) has been able to validate the data curation pipeline on ~3.2M tokens. We’ve now landed a small NSF-funded extension to finish annotation for the remaining 1.1M tokens, but our institutional procurement timeline means we can’t get a PO in place before the work window closes (mid-June).

Would Redwood be able to provide a short-term supplement (trial/top-up) — roughly $5k of credits or equivalent token allocation — so we can complete the curated dataset and reproduce results for the final paper? We’re a non-profit academic consortium; the work is non-commercial and will be released under an open dataset license. We attached a one-page scope and an estimated usage spreadsheet.

If you need a confirmation letter from the PI or a short MOU, we can provide that quickly. Appreciate any flexibility — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Hannah
Dr. Hannah Li
Research Director, MURC
Midwest University

Attachments:
- consortium_scope.pdf (one-page scope)
- usage-projections.xlsx (estimated token usage and researcher list)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Hannah Li <hannah.li@midwest.edu>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Summer compute supplement for Data Curation Consortium

Hi Hannah — thanks for the note and for the clear attachments. Quick clarifying questions before I escalate to the promotions/credits team:

- Can you confirm the number of active researchers who will be making API requests concurrently (approx)?
- Is any of the data controlled or subject to restricted data policies (PII, medical, etc.)?
- Would you be able to accept a short-term promo credit plus a simple MOU (we can use our template) that states the dataset is non-commercial and open?

If those answers look good I’ll check with my manager for discretionary support and loop in Priya on CS for onboarding/usage guardrails. If it helps I can also propose a conditional supplement (e.g., $5k credit valid for 60 days) to cover the June window.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:18:00 -04:00

Thanks for flagging, Ben. I reviewed the scope and usage projection — looks like a small, time-bound academic ask. Approve a discretionary promo of up to $5,000 in hosted credits (valid for 60 days) under the EDU promotional policy, conditional on:

- A one-paragraph MOU from the consortium confirming non-commercial/open dataset intent (Priya, I’ll attach the standard template)
- A short post-project writeup (1 page) for our case studies page (we can make the language reviewable by MURC)

Priya — can you take point on the MOU and onboarding checklist? Also include a usage alert so we don’t exceed the approved spend. Ben — once Priya confirms MOU timing, you can send the approval + DocuSign link to Hannah.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah — good news: we can provide a $5,000 hosted-credit supplement valid for 60 days to cover the June annotation window, conditional on a short MOU confirming the dataset will be released under a non-commercial/open license. Priya (CC) will send the MOU template and a brief onboarding note with usage limits so you don’t accidentally hit paid thresholds.

Next steps:
- Priya to send MOU (DocuSign) and onboarding checklist — please sign and return ASAP
- We’ll provision $5,000 in promo credits after MOU is executed (credits applied to your account)
- Priya will offer a 15-min sync to set up usage alerts and safe-guards

Links/refs:
